title: 2026 GCF HGV distance and tonne-km basis QA

sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors for company reporting: Methodology paper

facts.source_fact: The 2026 HGV factors represent Great Britain fleet usage rather than a single vehicle measurement.
UK-average rigid and articulated factors are provided when a weight class is not known.
facts.expected_handling: Use aggregate factor only when class detail is unavailable.

facts.source_fact: An all-HGV aggregate factor is also provided for analyses without rigid/articulated detail.
Delivery-vehicle HGV factors are provided in distance units.
Distance-based emissions use kilometres travelled multiplied by the appropriate HGV factor.
Loading extent is used where it is known.
Freighting-goods factors are also provided in tonne-km units for intermodal comparison.
Tonne-km factors are available for rigid, articulated and aggregate HGV classes.
A tonne-km equals freight weight multiplied by distance travelled.
The 2026 set provides tonne-km factors for 0%, 50%, 100% and average loads.
